title: Insanity's Kiss
summary: Drink to lose control and become hostile to all other creatures for 5 turns.

fields.Throw: Throwing destroys the potion without applying its effect.
fields.Inspiration: Drinking grants An Acquired Taste to Guild Artisans.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. For 5 turns lose control and become hostile to all other creatures.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
